faq_answer: Founded in 2010, 'Discount PRO' is South Asia's largest discounts, offers, and cashback website. At 'Discount PRO', we help you save money through our comprehensive listing of coupons, offers, deals and discounts from popular online brands.

faq_question: What are the benefits of using 'Discount PRO'?
faq_answer:
Before you shop online, you should visit 'Discount PRO' to get these benefits:

1. Real Money as cashback - 'Discount PRO' offers DiscountPRO Cashback on the majority of popular stores - these are extra savings you get in your DiscountPRO account. This cashback is OVER & ABOVE the offers/discounts & coupons on the store and can be withdrawn without a fee/deduction.

Note: 'Discount PRO' provides the highest and best Cashback rates on most popular websites.

2. Shopping Assistant: We know it can be difficult to find a good coupon or deal at the right time. So we bring to you the shopping assistant on Chrome and Android (part of the 'Discount PRO' Android app) that reminds you to 'Activate Cashback' and tell you the best offers available WHILE you shop.

3. DiscountPRO Special Coupon Codes: We have Special Coupon Codes on many stores. You can also use 'Discount PRO' to easily search for coupons on a store, category or all.

4. Easy to find store deals for the best discounts: We show you all the available deals of a store in one place, making it easier for you to pick the best one.

DiscountPRO Cashback is real money that you can earn over & above the discounts you get when shopping online. Stores and offers that have additional cashback can be identified by looking for labels in green, like '+ Upto 5% DiscountPRO Cashback'.

The cashback you earn from 'Discount PRO' can be in the form of:

1. DiscountPRO Cashback - When you shop on any store except TechGizmo & BookNook. All withdrawal options are available.

2. DiscountPRO Rewards - Only when you shop on TechGizmo. All withdrawal options are available EXCEPT Bank Account withdrawal.

3. DiscountPRO Voucher Rewards - Only when you shop on BookNook. Can ONLY be withdrawn as BookNook Pay Voucher.

Irrespective of the type of cashback above, the entire amount can be withdrawn without any fee to multiple mediums as per your convenience. Check Withdrawal options for more.

DiscountPRO Rewards is cashback earned when you shop on TechGizmo via 'Discount PRO'.

This cashback is given the different name 'DiscountPRO Rewards' because TechGizmo does not allow withdrawal of this cashback to a bank account.

The process for earning of DiscountPRO Rewards is the same as DiscountPRO Cashback. DiscountPRO Rewards can be withdrawn and used for mobile or DTH Recharge and converted to TechGizmo Gift Card. In short, you can withdraw DiscountPRO Rewards as you like, except to a bank account. This is why the balance available for bank transfer may be less than your total available balance.
